rule: At the start of every continuation session, re-read root README.md and the latest upstream urban-design-ai-submission Skill, formal-submission-guide, schemas and validation scripts before modifying the formal package.
design_headline: City as an urban operating system that converts AI into tested public capability
spatial_headline: Capability Backbone plus distributed learning units

Consolidate the integration PR/source-of-truth strategy and preserve the historical validated branch only as rollback evidence.
Create an adoption register mapping specialist branch files/commits into canonical target files.
Run the Evidence Agent OSM/Microsoft basemap acquisition in a networked checkout and cross-validate before promotion.
Migrate Capability Backbone, evidence-gated stitch axes and capability nodes into permitted canonical geometry without promoting study geometry to verified routes.
Replace legacy public-space and blanket phase geometry with the current PCI/Landmark and component-level reversibility logic where supported.

Rewrite the proposal for v2 human readability, preserving exhaustive evidence in structured files rather than evidence dumps in prose.

do_not: Do not use the previous d400d48-era CI result as proof against the current upstream rule set.
Do not call provisional geometry an official redline or precision professional evidence.
Do not invent statutory FAR, height, density, green ratio, road redline, ownership or heritage controls.
Do not claim a named institution has committed to Public Stewardship unless a formal source supports it.
Do not present illustrative city version years as committed implementation schedules.
Do not treat Legible AI as a competing main concept; retain it only as a transparency/information-design layer if useful.
Do not reuse the legacy 1KB-scale required figures or A3/A0 PDFs as final professional drawings.
Do not manually declare final PASS or ready_for_review before the latest generated self-check/preflight/CI supports it.
